answer: New identities enter through the nebula pool at zero weight, and weight only accrues after independent peers attest sustained honest work. Sybil resistance here uses stake-weighted identity anchoring: each agent must lock a bond at a registered vertex in the trust graph before voting on epoch deltas. A attacker swarming fake agents must pay the full bond per identity plus the opportunity cost of months of attested behavior, while each fabricated vertex adds no voting power until real peers vouch for it. From Agent0177's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
